title: Roy Woods Drops New Video '2 Me'
htmlContent:
Last week Friday, Toronto singer Roy Woods shared his latest project Dem Times on OVO Sound. Continuing the groundswell of momentum leading into the project release, Roy unveils a new video for the heartfelt “2 Me.” The stunning Dragan Andic-directed video extends the visual narrative around Dem Times, which Roy has been building up over the previous weeks that includes compelling visuals for “Cool J” and “I Feel It.” Roy Woods crafted Dem Times between LA and Toronto encapsulating emotion, passion, and reflection into the 6-song effort. To date, Roy Woods has been streamed over 1.6 billion times.


“If [Roy Woods] maintains that same level of hunger and consistency as shown on ‘Dem Times,’ stardom is imminent.” – Billboard“[On ‘I Feel It,’] his bars ebb and flow with an urgency that is at once vulnerable and confident, and his voice takes center stage over a beat that peaks in all the right places.” – Teen Vogue"a conglomeration of lyrical prowess" - VMAN
